doNow.prompt: What happens to liquid water when the sun heats it in a puddle?

choices.text: It evaporates into invisible water vapour.
It disappears for good.
choices.misconception: Water disappears for good once it evaporates.

rationale.chose: The learner selected option It disappears for good. as their answer to this question.
rationale.thinks: They are applying the coded wrong turn instead of checking what each part of the working represents.
rationale.reteach: Reteach by tracing one drop through evaporation into invisible vapour, condensation into a cloud, and rain back into collection.
